title: Valve's zoo_standards (draft)
about: Valve's own zoo_standards, measured by map_ingest.py on 2026-11-21 (play space only: hidden objects and the 3D skybox room left out) and drawn by map_view.py (flat colours; props are boxes of their true size, orange static, yellow physics, cyan dynamic, green NPCs; trees drawn as trunk and canopy, poles thin). Reference only: the VMF is not in the repo. DRAFT: a reviewer fills in what each picture teaches, picks the lessons, and removes "draft".

Lights: 0 light (median brightness None), 0 light_spot (median None), 0 point_spotlight, 0 env_sprite; no light_environment; no fog controller; sky sky_wasteland02.
